# Deezer

French music streaming service, best known for Flow — its personalized endless mix.

## Market position

A niche player globally (single-digit share), strong in France and Brazil. Alongside Spotify, one of only two services with public quarterly reporting.

## Features vs Spotify

- **Flow** — an "endless mix" blending favourites with new discoveries, with mood/activity variants; since 2026 **Flow Tuner** gives users explicit sliders to control recommendations — exactly the algorithm control the Spotify community keeps asking for.
- HiFi as standard.

## Comparison

| Category | Where they stand |
|---|---|
| Price (individual) | **$11.99/mo** (US) — priced level with Spotify ([Deezer offers](https://www.deezer.com/offers)) |
| Free tier | Yes — ad-supported, with shuffle limits on mobile |
| Audio quality | HiFi (FLAC) as standard in the paid plan |
| Algorithm control | The strongest story on this axis: **Flow Tuner** hands users explicit sliders over recommendations ([Deezer Newsroom](https://newsroom-deezer.com/2026/02/deezer-launches-flow-tuner-personalized-recommendations/)) — and the "Flow is trash" thread shows what breaks when control is taken away ([community](https://en.deezercommunity.com/features-feedback-44/flow-is-trash-77669)) |
| Library & ownership | Streaming only — parity with Spotify, no ownership angle |

## User voices

- Fans praise Flow for accuracy and "less clicking" ([Deezer Community: What do you think of Flow?](https://en.deezercommunity.com/features-feedback-44/feedback-what-do-you-think-of-flow-24402/index2.html)).
- Critics just as loud: the "Flow is trash" thread — after algorithm changes users lost their favourite balance of familiar and new ([Deezer Community](https://en.deezercommunity.com/features-feedback-44/flow-is-trash-77669)). Lesson: even a good context feature breaks when you take control away from the user.

## What this means for our personas

- Flow Tuner is market proof that "algorithm control" ([Doesn't trust Discover Weekly](../Signals/Doesn%27t%20trust%20Discover%20Weekly.md), [The Algorithm Drifter](../Archetypes/The%20Algorithm%20Drifter.md)) is buildable — a competitor is already shipping it.
